description: This file contains utility functions for COSA DML API development, including functions for string manipulation, network interface querying, and configuration path retrieval, primarily used in network device management.

methods.name: interface_type_from_name
methods.description: Determines the device interface type based on the interface name string.

methods.name: CosaUtilStringToHex
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a byte array.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetIfAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of a network interface.

methods.name: CosaSListPushEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Inserts a context link object into a sorted list based on its instance number.

methods.name: CosaSListGetEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Retrieves a context link object from a list by its instance number.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetLowerLayers
methods.description: Finds the lower layer path matching a keyword within specified table names.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetFullPathNameByKeyword
methods.description: Finds the full path name in configuration tables matching a keyword.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetStaticRouteTable
methods.description: Retrieves the static route table entries.
